column1: # Repositories to keep on the tezb dev box. Tab-separated.
# linux: yes      builds and runs on tezb
#        partial  edits here, but the shippable artifact is built on the Mac
#        no       macOS-only app; kept here so agents can read and edit it
# Every remote is https:// and authenticates through the GitHub CLI's credential
# helper (`gh auth login` then `gh auth setup-git`), which stores an absolute path
# to gh, so it also works in a non-interactive shell. One account then covers the
# public and the private repositories, and no SSH key has to be managed.
# branch "-" means the remote's default branch. dev.sh repos sync clones the
# missing ones and fast-forwards the rest; it never force-updates a local branch.
